t_advice_summary_textbox.text: it doesnt matter which one you pick but watch out for the x5

vb_textbox.text: The 5X is important, this gives you the best score and focus on this.  The colour and type of the gnome doesn't seem to matter, nor doe the colour of the basket.  Have your hand resting on both keys and the space bar and its easier to click the keyboard before the 1.5s are up.  Good luck and enjoy!
